description: This Java source file defines the class 'OtherMetadataFragment', a Fragment subclass for Android. It demonstrates how to attach metadata such as priority, category, and person data to notifications, including UI components to select metadata and trigger notifications with these settings.

classes.name: OtherMetadataFragment
classes.description: An Android Fragment that demonstrates setting notification metadata such as category, priority, and person data, including UI interactions for selecting contact and notification options.

classes.name: Category
classes.description: Enum representing various notification categories such as alarm, call, email, message, and system.

classes.name: Priority
classes.description: Enum representing notification priority levels, mapped to Android's Notification.PRIORITY_* constants.

methods.name: createNotification
methods.description: Creates a Notification object with specified priority, category, and contact URI, including attaching person and large icon if contact info is available.

methods.name: showNotificationClicked
methods.description: Handles the button click event to build and display a notification with selected metadata.

methods.name: findContact
methods.description: Starts an activity for selecting a contact from the contacts database.

methods.name: loadBitmapFromContactUri
methods.description: Loads a contact photo as Bitmap from the contact's URI.

methods.name: updateContactEntryFromUri
methods.description: Updates UI elements with contact's name and photo upon contact selection.
